# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 10 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Greek MS | **Section:** The Man of God Speaks to Aseneth; She Is Transformed

---

**1** 'Courage, Aseneth,' the man said. 'Don't be afraid. Stand up — I have something to tell you.'

**2** Aseneth stood up. The man said: 'Take off that mourning robe. Shake the ash from your head. Wash your face and hands with clean, fresh water. Put on a new, clean white garment, and tie a bright girdle around you.'

**3** 'Come back to me, and I will speak words of life to you.'

**4** Aseneth rushed to her room, put on a fresh white linen dress, tied on a golden belt, wrapped a golden linen cloth around her head, and came back to the man.

**5** 'Take the covering off your head,' the man said. 'Today you are a holy virgin, and your head should be uncovered like a young man's.'

**6** Aseneth took off the head-covering.

**7** 'Be encouraged, Aseneth. The Lord God has heard your confession and seen the humility of your heart. You lowered yourself before him and came under the shelter of the wings of God Most High.'

**8** 'Your name has been written in the Book of Life in heaven. It will never, ever be erased.'

**9** 'Starting today you are renewed — remade, given new life. You will eat the bread of blessing, drink the cup of immortality, be anointed with the oil that never corrupts.'

**10** 'Take heart, Aseneth. Today I am giving you to Joseph as his bride. Your name will no longer be Aseneth. Your name will be City of Refuge — because many nations will find shelter in you, and under your wings many peoples who trust in the Lord God Most High will be protected.'

**11** Aseneth was overwhelmed with joy at what the man said. She fell at his feet: 'Lord, have mercy on me, your servant. I spoke wickedly — I had no idea that Joseph was your son.'

**12** 'Joseph is indeed a son of God,' the man said, 'a son of the power of God. This is the mystery of the Most High. I cannot say more about this mystery to you.'

**13** The man asked Aseneth: 'Have you heard what I have said to you?'

**14** 'Yes, lord,' she said. 'I heard every word.'

**15** 'From this day forward,' the man said, 'you will eat the bread of life, drink the cup of immortality, and be anointed with the incorruptible oil. Your youth will never fade. Your beauty will never fail. You will be like a fortified city, forever.'

**16** Aseneth said to the man: 'My lord, please sit a moment. Let me bring you a table with bread to eat, and some aged wine with a wonderful fragrance to drink — and then you can go.'

**17** The man said: 'Bring a honeycomb too.' Aseneth hesitated — she had no honeycomb in her pantry.

**18** The man said: 'Go to your inner room — you'll find one there.' Aseneth went in and found a honeycomb on the table — large, snow-white, full of honey, with a fragrance like the breath of life.

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
